## Goal
Register a docs-style DataSource so partials and SKILL.md directives can resolve `base.skills.rule`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Method `rule` returns a Renderable for the body of the rule whose id is given.
- Throws on unknown id when invoked directly.
- File is named `skills.js` so loader-derived source name is `skills`.

## Implementation Notes
Factory `register(container)` shape; obtain `DataSource` and `Paragraph` from container.

## Test Strategy
Unit test covers PASS, missing-id, and unknown-id paths.
